## About
Norcross Transmission Service is a family-owned and operated transmission rebuilding and repair shop in Norcross, serving Gwinnett County and the surrounding areas. We work on foreign and domestic cars, and we also do general auto care.
Over the years we've built long-lasting relationships with our customers. Our aim is to earn your trust through integrity and quality of service. When you call, you'll likely talk to Jim, and our customers rate us 4.5 from 79 Google reviews.

## Services
- Transmission rebuilding and repair: Service, repair, rebuild and replace. This is what we've specialized in for a long time.
- Automatic and Manual transmissions: We work on both, for foreign and domestic vehicles.
- Light and Medium duty: We work on light and medium duty vehicles.
- Cars, Trucks SUVs and Vans: Whatever you drive, bring it by and we'll take a look.
- General auto care services: Beyond transmissions, we handle general auto care for our customers.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Contact us and we'll give you a free estimate.

Q: Is your work guaranteed?
A: Our repair services are guaranteed, and we also offer warranties.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We service foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Can you handle work trucks?
A: Yes. We specialize in commercial vehicles like light-duty and medium-duty trucks.
